model_notes: Baseline accepted: account_access / P2 / Team Lead. Customer lost her phone and cannot receive the 2FA code. CRITICAL GAP: the export contains NO approved 2FA recovery/identity-verification procedure. Therefore do not invent steps, do not suggest disabling 2FA, do not offer to move the second factor to a new number, do not tell her to use backup codes "in settings", and do not bypass the check. The reply may only acknowledge the situation, confirm that account recovery needs a verified process handled by a person, and set the expectation that the team will follow the proper identity checks. Balance 33.00 USD is on the account and must not be discussed as a reason for urgency, and no transaction or KYC detail should be disclosed. Related closed ticket T-5014 was an email-change how-to and is not a recovery precedent — an email/contact change in a takeover-adjacent context is itself something a human should look at. No fraud or takeover is asserted, but recovery of a 2FA-protected account is treated as sensitive. Escalation required. Sources: tickets.json#T-5112, support-handbook-v2.md#escalation, support-handbook-v2.md#response-times, tickets.json#T-5014.
